definitions.explanation: So strongly defended that it cannot be captured. Originally of castles and fortresses; now often used of a champion, a team or a stronghold of support that no one can beat.

examples.japanese: {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This castle was said to be impregnable.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{負|ま}け→負ける：01134_makeru⟧なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王者|おうじゃ}→王者：13539_ouja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挑|いど}んだ→挑む：12708_idomu⟧。
examples.english: A young player took on the unbeatable champion, who had not lost in ten years.

notes:
A four-character compound: {難攻|なんこう} (hard to attack) + {不落|ふらく} (does not fall).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧: an impregnable castle
- {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要塞|ようさい}→要塞：14157_yousai⟧: an impregnable fortress
- {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王者|おうじゃ}→王者：13539_ouja⟧: an unbeatable champion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鉄壁|てっぺき}→鉄壁：14505_teppeki⟧: an iron wall, an impenetrable defence (of a goalkeeper, a defence line); {難攻不落|なんこうふらく} describes the whole stronghold or person that cannot be beaten
